stem.text: A straight copper wire of diameter $0.42 \times 10^{-3}\,\text{m}$ has a number density of free electrons of $8.5 \times 10^{28}\,\text{m}^{-3}$. In a given time interval, a charge of $0.15\,\text{C}$ moves through the wire.
What is the average displacement of the free electrons along the wire in this time interval?
